scope: Conservative first accepted MouldMaster registry of injection-moulding sensor, signal-integrity and machine-health concepts. Every concept has source-supported measurement semantics or bounded diagnostic meaning, explicit confounders and traceable measured evidence. Numerical values remain source-specific and no signal is treated as automatic root-cause proof.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Pressure sensor mounted in the mould cavity in direct contact with polymer flow; exact position in the flow path must remain attached to the measurement.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Pressure in bar where documented by OpenMMS; other sources retain their source engineering units and field metadata.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Cavity pressure is a direct local process measurement and can support filling/packing/quality reasoning, but a pressure value or curve alone is not proof of one physical root cause.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Features derived from a cavity-pressure time history while retaining sensor position, cycle linkage and time basis.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Peak, timing, area/integral and curve-shape descriptors inherit pressure/time units from the source trace; feature definitions must be stored explicitly.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Pressure-curve features can discriminate process states or correlate with quality, but feature importance and prediction accuracy do not establish physical causation.

evidence.role: pressure-time feature linked to measured part weight

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Comparison of cavity-pressure traces at different physical locations within one mould/cavity system.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Relative timing, filling-phase shape and local pressure response must be interpreted with the physical sensor map, not as interchangeable scalar channels.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Spatial pressure differences can indicate local filling or tool-condition effects, but similar curve asymmetry in another mould does not prove the same venting, wear or alignment cause.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Dynisco viscometer front pressure sensor mounted at the injection nozzle in the SKZ LoKI experiment.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct pressure in bar; exact checksum-matched field MEAS_pressure_frontsensor_bar sampled at approximately 10 kHz.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Use as a local measured nozzle-side pressure trace; do not convert source-specific pressure magnitudes into universal machine-pressure limits.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Dynisco viscometer back pressure sensor in the nozzle-mounted SKZ LoKI measurement arrangement.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct pressure in bar; exact checksum-matched field MEAS_pressure_backsensor_bar sampled at approximately 10 kHz.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Use as the second local physical pressure channel and preserve its position relative to the front sensor; it is not interchangeable with machine hydraulic pressure.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Difference feature derived from the two physical SKZ nozzle/viscometer pressure channels.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: bar; source field MEAS_pressure_difference_bar. It remains classified as derived and is not counted as an additional direct measured scalar channel.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Useful as a source-defined differential feature only when the two underlying pressure sensors and sign convention are preserved.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Thermocouple measurement in the mould plate; exact sensor position and distinction from melt temperature must be retained.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: °C in the OpenMMS source UI/CSV semantics.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: A mould-plate thermocouple measures a local thermal response and must not be treated as the polymer melt temperature or as a universal cavity-surface value.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Force sensor installed in one extraction/ejector pin of the mould.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: N in OpenMMS; measured extraction force is local to the instrumented pin and extraction mechanism.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: The measured force can expose release-system changes but one pin does not necessarily measure total ejection load for the full mould.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Extraction-force response during a controlled extraction-system fault introduced at the instrumented pin.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Change in N-valued extraction-force waveform/peak relative to the same mould's normal operating sequence.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: A load increase under the controlled OpenMMS fault supports extraction-system health monitoring, but the same force change elsewhere may arise from cooling, shrinkage, surface or alignment causes.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Three-axis accelerometer mounted on the mould extraction plate.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source software labels the axes as g, but raw stationary values indicate an embedded scale factor; MouldMaster preserves raw values and the source label without undocumented rescaling.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Use the raw axes as source-scaled inertial measurements unless a validated calibration/scale conversion is available.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Three-axis gyroscope on the extraction-plate inertial module.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Source software label dps/1000 is retained verbatim; raw values are not silently rescaled.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Angular-velocity axes are useful for extraction-motion signatures only with the original orientation/scale semantics or a validated recalibration.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Multisensor acquisition where temperature/pressure/force and inertial modules carry separate clocks.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Seconds on separate t and t2 axes; do not force an undocumented one-to-one timestamp mapping.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Cross-sensor timing comparisons require explicit synchronisation evidence; convenience interpolation must be marked as derived rather than treated as original timing.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Machine/process injection-pressure time series captured through the Arburg/AVAPS data path; exact machine signal location remains attached to the dataset.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Cycle-linked numeric pressure curve sampled every 6 ms in the published scatimdata experiments; engineering unit must remain the source field's unit metadata.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Injection-pressure waveform shape can support process/quality monitoring, but it is not automatically equivalent to local cavity pressure.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Machine-reported injection-flow time series from the Arburg/AVAPS experimental data path.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Cycle-linked numeric injection-flow curve sampled every 6 ms in scatimdata; preserve source signal naming and engineering units.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Machine-reported flow is useful for within-system comparisons; cross-machine volumetric equivalence requires validated signal semantics and screw geometry.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Machine/MES screw position at the end of hold pressure on an Engel E-MAC production press.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: cm for iGuzzini field CPn - Screw position at the end of hold pressure.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Use as a machine-specific end-of-hold position/cushion-related indicator; numerical values do not transfer directly across screw units or machines.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Machine/MES torque peak for the current plasticising/moulding cycle on an Engel E-MAC production press.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: N*m for iGuzzini field Ms - Torque peak value current cycle.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Torque changes can indicate altered plasticising load or material/process state, but they do not uniquely diagnose wear, contamination or viscosity without corroborating evidence.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Machine/MES clamping-force peak value for a production moulding cycle.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: N for iGuzzini field SKs - Clamping force peak value.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Machine clamp-force values support within-machine load monitoring; they are not a universal flash threshold or proof of mould protection condition.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Machine/MES specific back-pressure peak during plasticising on the Engel E-MAC production press.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: bar for iGuzzini field APSs - Specific back pressure peak value.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Treat as a machine-specific plasticising load indicator; it must not be equated automatically with nozzle or cavity pressure.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: External strain measurement on an injection-moulding machine tie bar, used as a clamping-force/load proxy in production validation.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Strain-derived clamping/load signal; exact scaling/calibration remains study- and installation-specific.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: External tie-bar strain can support repeatable load monitoring after local calibration, but it is not inherently equal to total clamp force across machines.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Physical post-moulding part-weight measurement linked back to an individual moulding cycle or experimental run.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Mass/weight value using the source dataset's scale; the cycle linkage is part of the measurement semantics.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Part weight is a useful physical quality outcome and process-consistency proxy, but it does not by itself identify the mechanism causing a change.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: RMS feature generated from in-mould ultrasound channels in the FORinFPRO hybrid injection-moulding sensor package.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Ultrasound RMS amplitude feature; physical source headers do not yet provide a normalized engineering unit, so the feature remains source-scaled.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Use as a source-scaled ultrasound feature within the instrumented mould context unless independent calibration establishes transferable physical units.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Per-phase active electrical power from Shelly Pro 3EM meters on a real injection-moulding plant energy-monitoring installation.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: W for phases A, B and C; total/aggregate fields remain separate from the direct per-phase measurements.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Per-phase active power supports machine/auxiliary state and energy-loss analysis only when the measured electrical boundary and production-state context are known.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Per-phase apparent electrical power from Shelly Pro 3EM meters on the monitored injection-moulding plant equipment.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: VA for phases A, B and C.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Apparent power is not interchangeable with active energy consumption; interpret it with the electrical boundary and load context.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Per-phase electrical current measured by Shelly Pro 3EM devices on the plant energy-monitoring boundary.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: A for phases A, B and C; empty neutral-current field is explicitly excluded.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Current changes can support state/load monitoring but cannot be assigned to a specific motor or mechanism unless the electrical measurement boundary isolates that load.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Per-phase supply voltage measured by Shelly Pro 3EM devices at the monitored plant electrical boundary.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: V for phases A, B and C.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Voltage is a supply-condition signal; deviations should not be interpreted as machine faults without electrical-system context.

concepts.measurementLocationOrDomain: Per-phase mains frequency measured by Shelly Pro 3EM devices at the injection-plant electrical boundary.
concepts.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Hz for phases A, B and C.
concepts.diagnosticUseBoundary: Frequency is primarily an electrical-supply integrity signal and should not be treated as an injection-process fault indicator without corroborating evidence.
